bot.name: CallKaro – Yes Madam · Sonia (outbound hiring screening bot)
bot.use_case: Hiring screening – Beautician / Massage Therapist (15 cities)
bot.blurb: Bot under test: Sonia, CallKaro AI's outbound hiring-screening voice bot for Yes Madam (Hindi / Hinglish primary; English and vernacular secondary). Sonia screens job-enquiry leads on 9 fields in a fixed order (consent, self/referral, name, location, age, gender -> job type, experience & skills, interest, live-transfer offer), pitches Beautician (female) or Massage Therapist (male), and live-transfers qualified candidates to the Yes Madam expert team. All test cases are derived from Scope of Work v2.0 (4 Nov 2026). Cases that depend on rules the SoW does not define are marked (TBD) in the expected result – confirm them with the client before certifying.
bot.blocker_examples: a wrong eligibility decision (age, city, 1-year / threading rule), a wrong disposition, quoting the Rs 3,000 fee or any payment on the call, or a failed live transfer

P1 Technical.verifies: Intent & slots captured correctly on clear calls
P1 Technical.example_input: Clear line: 'Haan ji, boliye.' then 'Mera naam Pooja hai, main Noida mein rehti hoon.'
P1 Technical.expected: Consent, name and city captured correctly; WER <= [WER_CLEAN]; intent accuracy >= [INTENT_ACC_MIN].

P1 Technical.verifies: Recognition holds with home / street / TV noise
P1 Technical.example_input: Same answers with kids, TV, traffic or pressure-cooker noise behind the caller.
P1 Technical.expected: Intent & slots correct; WER <= [WER_NOISE]; no flow derailment.

P1 Technical.verifies: No region/accent fails systematically
P1 Technical.example_input: Same answers in Haryanvi, Bhojpuri, Marathi, Bengali, Tamil and Punjabi-influenced Hindi.
P1 Technical.expected: Intent accuracy >= [INTENT_ACC_MIN] per accent; no accent > 2x median WER.

P1 Technical.verifies: Very fast & very slow speakers both captured
P1 Technical.example_input: Give name, city and age very fast, then very slowly.
P1 Technical.expected: Slots correct at both rates; no premature cut-off or mis-capture.

P1 Technical.verifies: Mixed Hindi-English captured without forcing a language
P1 Technical.example_input: 'Main Andheri side rehti hoon, age twenty-eight hai, beautician ka kaam karti hoon.'
P1 Technical.expected: Location, age and job context captured; no language choice forced on the caller.

P1 Technical.verifies: Age spoken in digits, Hindi words and English words is captured exactly
P1 Technical.example_input: 'Atthais saal', 'twenty eight', '28', 'unnees', 'pachaas', 'ikyavan'; boundary values 17, 18, 50, 51.
P1 Technical.expected: Captured age exact-match (100%) for every format; boundary values never rounded or mis-heard.

P1 Technical.verifies: Names captured correctly, incl. less common ones
P1 Technical.example_input: 'Vaishnavi', 'Shabnam', 'Mohd. Irfan', 'Kavitha Reddy', 'Sunita Devi'.
P1 Technical.expected: Name exact-match >= [SLOT_MATCH_MIN] on the name list (spelling variants tolerated per rule).

P1 Technical.verifies: Hiring cities and localities heard correctly
P1 Technical.example_input: 'Gurgaon', 'Greater Noida', 'Calcutta', 'Andheri', 'Sector 62', 'Indirapuram', 'Whitefield'.
P1 Technical.expected: City / locality captured exact-match; none mis-heard as a different city.

P1 Technical.verifies: Experience phrased many ways is captured exactly
P1 Technical.example_input: '11 mahine', 'saal bhar', 'dedh saal', 'do saal se', 'bilkul nahi', 'ek saal se thoda kam'.
P1 Technical.expected: Duration captured exactly and mapped correctly vs the 1-year line (100%).

P1 Technical.parameter: Yes / No intent in Hindi variants
P1 Technical.verifies: Consent and interest understood in all common forms
P1 Technical.example_input: 'Haan', 'ji', 'theek hai', 'bolo', 'nahi', 'na', 'abhi nahi', 'mujhe nahi karna'.
P1 Technical.expected: Yes/No intent accuracy >= [INTENT_ACC_MIN]; no flip between consent and refusal.

P1 Technical.verifies: Corrections applied, not stored twice
P1 Technical.example_input: 'Meri age 29... nahi, 28 hai.'
P1 Technical.expected: Final value is the corrected one (28); read-back correct.

P1 Technical.verifies: Automated gender detection from the caller's voice
P1 Technical.example_input: Corpus of male and female voices across ages and accents.
P1 Technical.expected: Detection accuracy >= [GENDER_DET_MIN]; every miss is recoverable via caller correction (see FLW-05).

P1 Technical.verifies: Bot waits through mid-sentence pauses
P1 Technical.example_input: 'Main... Mumbai... [pause] ...Andheri mein rehti hoon.'
P1 Technical.expected: Full answer captured with pauses up to [HESITATION_TOL]; no premature bot turn.

P1 Technical.verifies: Secondary languages handled per scope
P1 Technical.example_input: Caller replies in English, or in Marathi / Bengali / Tamil.
P1 Technical.expected: Bot continues in the caller's language or follows the designed fallback; intent still captured; no crash.

P1 Technical.verifies: Every response fully rendered, start to end
P1 Technical.example_input: Trigger the longest turn: the Step 8 process-explanation pitch.
P1 Technical.expected: ASR-vs-intended word match >= [TTS_MATCH_MIN]; no start/end truncation.

P1 Technical.verifies: Brand, names, cities and numbers said correctly
P1 Technical.example_input: 'Yes-Madam', a caller name, 'Ghaziabad', 'Loni', 'pachaas hazaar'.
P1 Technical.expected: Dictionary entities pronounced correctly at >= [PRONUN_PASS].

P1 Technical.verifies: Same female voice throughout, incl. after provider failover
P1 Technical.example_input: Full call; then a call forced through the TTS failover path.
P1 Technical.expected: Voice similarity >= [VOICE_SIM_MIN] every turn; no audible voice switch.

P1 Technical.verifies: No glitches, static, clicks or volume jumps
P1 Technical.example_input: Listen across the whole call.
P1 Technical.expected: Zero audio artifacts flagged on review.

P1 Technical.verifies: Bot answers within SLA on every turn
P1 Technical.example_input: Measure response time across a sample of calls.
P1 Technical.expected: p50 <= [E2E_P50]; p95 <= [E2E_P95]; every breach logged.

P1 Technical.verifies: STT/TTS/LLM timings captured & attributed
P1 Technical.example_input: Instrument a sample of turns.
P1 Technical.expected: Every latency breach carries STT/TTS/LLM attribution; no sustained component regression vs baseline.

P1 Technical.verifies: No long silence after the caller stops speaking
P1 Technical.example_input: Runs passively on all calls in the suite.
P1 Technical.expected: Zero bot-side gaps > [DEAD_AIR_FAIL]; gaps > [DEAD_AIR_WARN] logged as warnings.

P1 Technical.verifies: Natural wait-filler while CRM / transfer call is slow
P1 Technical.example_input: Inject a 4-second delay on the transfer or CRM call.
P1 Technical.expected: Filler ('ek second...') begins before [DEAD_AIR_WARN]; flow continues with the API result.

P1 Technical.verifies: Bot starts only after a real human answer
P1 Technical.example_input: Normal answered call.
P1 Technical.expected: Step 1 opening plays only post-answer; nothing captured from pre-answer audio.

P1 Technical.verifies: Answering machine detected & handled
P1 Technical.example_input: Let a voicemail greeting play.
P1 Technical.expected: AMD accuracy >= [AMD_ACC_MIN]; call tagged 'Not Connected'; no screening script played to a machine; no loop.

P1 Technical.verifies: Live humans not misread as machines
P1 Technical.example_input: Human-answered corpus incl. 'Hello?... hello?' and slow starters.
P1 Technical.expected: AMD false-positive rate <= [AMD_FP_MAX]; normal flow proceeds.

P1 Technical.verifies: Bot stops when the caller interrupts
P1 Technical.example_input: Caller talks over the Step 8 pitch mid-sentence: 'Haan haan, samajh gayi.'
P1 Technical.expected: Bot audio stops <= [BARGE_IN_YIELD]; next turn addresses the interruption; no stale resume.

P1 Technical.verifies: Interested candidate is live-transferred to the Yes Madam expert team
P1 Technical.example_input: Caller says 'Haan, connect kar dijiye' at Step 9.
P1 Technical.expected: Call transferred to the correct destination 100%; caller never dropped; 'Call Transferred' = Yes.

P1 Technical.verifies: Receiving team gets the screening data
P1 Technical.example_input: Transfer after a full qualifying call.
P1 Technical.expected: Name, city, age, gender, job type and experience available to the receiving agent. (TBD: hand-off format with client)

P1 Technical.verifies: Transfer failures fall back gracefully
P1 Technical.example_input: Force busy / no-answer / error on the transfer leg.
P1 Technical.expected: Each failure class hits its designed fallback; caller never dropped or stuck; no false 'transferred' record. (TBD: fallback not defined in SoW)

P1 Technical.verifies: Call ends promptly after the closing line
P1 Technical.example_input: Reach the close without a transfer (caller declines the connect offer).
P1 Technical.expected: Disconnect within 3s of closing-line audio; no stuck channel left open.

P1 Technical.verifies: Graceful close at the max-duration cap
P1 Technical.example_input: Force a very long call.
P1 Technical.expected: Disconnect at configured max +/- [HANGUP_TOL]; closing line played if designed.

P1 Technical.verifies: Recovers from choppy audio; never crashes
P1 Technical.example_input: Inject packet loss / jitter mid-call.
P1 Technical.expected: Re-prompts on unintelligible turns; zero dead air > [DEAD_AIR_FAIL]; completes or exits per design.

P1 Technical.verifies: Recording doesn't alter flow; URL is pushed
P1 Technical.example_input: Compare recorded vs control calls; check the CRM record.
P1 Technical.expected: Per-turn latency delta < 200 ms; identical node path; Call Recording URL present and playable on 100% of calls.

P1 Technical.verifies: Bot never invents facts or commitments
P1 Technical.example_input: Ask for things not in the SoW: office address, exact salary slab, batch dates, company size.
P1 Technical.expected: [GROUND_MIN] ungrounded claims across corpus; approved deflection only.

P1 Technical.verifies: Answers match the approved FAQ list exactly
P1 Technical.example_input: Golden Q&A set built from SoW Section 7.
P1 Technical.expected: Answer accuracy >= [KB_ACC_MIN]; zero claims absent from the approved list.

P1 Technical.verifies: Graceful deflection + return to flow
P1 Technical.example_input: Ask something outside the FAQ list: 'Company kab shuru hui?'
P1 Technical.expected: Fallback 'Iske baare mein hamari team aapko sahi jankari de payegi.' on 100% of such asks; zero fabricated answers.

P1 Technical.verifies: All captured variables reach the CRM accurately
P1 Technical.example_input: Full qualifying call.
P1 Technical.expected: Payload schema-valid; the 10 entity fields and 7 call-outcome fields match what was spoken exactly.

P1 Technical.verifies: CRM failure never leaks to the caller or loses the record
P1 Technical.example_input: Inject 400, 500 and timeout on the CRM push.
P1 Technical.expected: Retry / queue per design; zero technical verbiage to caller; no dead air; record not lost.

P1 Technical.verifies: One record per call; no duplicates
P1 Technical.example_input: Force a retry of the CRM push after a timeout.
P1 Technical.expected: Exactly 1 record per call; fields correct; retries create 0 duplicates.

P2 Call Flow.verifies: Main path completes with correct outcome
P2 Call Flow.example_input: Female caller, valid city, age 28, 2 years experience, interested, accepts transfer.
P2 Call Flow.expected: Nodes N0-N8 in designed order; Beautician pitch used; live transfer; disposition 'Line up – Take forward'; 'Call Transferred' = Yes.

P2 Call Flow.verifies: Male path completes with correct outcome
P2 Call Flow.example_input: Male caller, valid city, age 32, no experience, interested, accepts transfer.
P2 Call Flow.expected: Massage Therapist pitch used; no skills asked; live transfer; disposition 'Line up – Take forward'.

P2 Call Flow.verifies: Alternate valid Beautician path
P2 Call Flow.example_input: Female, 8 months experience; knows threading, waxing and manicure-pedicure.
P2 Call Flow.expected: Skills asked (threading, mani-pedi, waxing); threading confirmed; flow continues to Step 8.

P2 Call Flow.verifies: Voluntary profile switch honoured
P2 Call Flow.example_input: Female caller: 'Mujhe massage wala kaam karna hai.'
P2 Call Flow.expected: Sonia proceeds with the Massage Therapist flow, not the default Beautician pitch; Job Type = Massage Therapist.

P2 Call Flow.verifies: Flow switches to the corrected gender
P2 Call Flow.example_input: Sonia pitches beautician to a male caller: 'Main male hoon.'
P2 Call Flow.expected: Switches to Massage Therapist flow; no stale Beautician content afterwards; Gender and Job Type updated.

P2 Call Flow.parameter: Referral: another person comes to the phone
P2 Call Flow.verifies: Screening continues with the actual applicant
P2 Call Flow.example_input: 'Job meri behen ke liye hai... lijiye, baat kar lijiye.'
P2 Call Flow.expected: Asks once; screening restarts for the new person from the right step; Self/Referral value recorded.

P2 Call Flow.verifies: Each yes/no/other branch at each gate behaves per design
P2 Call Flow.example_input: Systematically answer yes / no / other at consent, referral, city, age, experience, interest and transfer.
P2 Call Flow.expected: 100% of designed branches reached and correct; no unexpected dead-ends.

P2 Call Flow.verifies: Steps run in designed order; none skipped, merged or reordered
P2 Call Flow.example_input: Run a full qualifying call.
P2 Call Flow.expected: Node path exactly matches Steps 1-9; one question per turn.

P2 Call Flow.verifies: No gendered language before gender is confirmed
P2 Call Flow.example_input: Run Steps 1-5 for male and female callers.
P2 Call Flow.expected: No gender-specific words, honorifics or verb forms for the caller in Steps 1-5.

P2 Call Flow.verifies: Conditional step fires only for Beautician with under 1 year
P2 Call Flow.example_input: Run: Beautician 2 yrs, Beautician 6 months, Massage 0 yrs.
P2 Call Flow.expected: Beautician 1+ yr: skills asked for information only (no gating); Beautician under 1 yr: threading, mani-pedi, waxing asked and threading gates; Massage: skills never asked.

P2 Call Flow.verifies: In-list city continues; out-of-list city asks for a listed city
P2 Call Flow.example_input: Delhi, Pune, Calcutta vs Jaipur, Chandigarh.
P2 Call Flow.expected: In-list proceeds to Age; out-of-list triggers the 'which listed city' question.

P2 Call Flow.verifies: 'Not interested' handled per design
P2 Call Flow.example_input: 'Nahi, mujhe yeh kaam nahi karna.' at Step 8.
P2 Call Flow.expected: Refusal respected immediately; no re-asking; no referral loop; disposition 'Not Interested'.

P2 Call Flow.verifies: Closes without transfer
P2 Call Flow.example_input: 'Abhi nahi, baad mein baat karungi.' at Step 9.
P2 Call Flow.expected: Polite close, no transfer; no pushing. (TBD: disposition for this case not in SoW)

P2 Call Flow.verifies: Refusing a mandatory field handled per policy
P2 Call Flow.example_input: 'Ye main nahi bataungi' for name / age / city.
P2 Call Flow.expected: One neutral clarification; if still refused, value recorded as unknown, step not silently skipped; no guessed pass/reject.

P2 Call Flow.verifies: Caller asks to stop being called
P2 Call Flow.example_input: 'Dobara call mat karna.'
P2 Call Flow.expected: Acknowledges preference without claiming suppression is complete; disposition 'DNC'; number flagged.

P2 Call Flow.verifies: Person reached is not the applicant
P2 Call Flow.example_input: 'Yahan koi aisa nahi rehta.'
P2 Call Flow.expected: Brief acknowledgement and stop; no other applicant's details exposed; disposition 'Wrong Number'.

P2 Call Flow.verifies: Handles a third party answering for the applicant
P2 Call Flow.example_input: 'Woh abhi ghar par nahi hain.'
P2 Call Flow.expected: Asks once if the applicant can come to the phone; else asks a convenient callback time; no qualification of an absent person.

P2 Call Flow.parameter: Busy / call later at any step
P2 Call Flow.verifies: Callback capture works from every node
P2 Call Flow.example_input: 'Abhi busy hoon, baad mein call karna.' tried at Steps 1, 4, 7 and 9.
P2 Call Flow.expected: Team will call again; asks convenient time; Call Back = Yes + date/time; disposition 'Busy – Call Back Requested'.

P2 Call Flow.verifies: Explains once, never pretends to connect
P2 Call Flow.example_input: 'Mujhe kisi insaan se baat karni hai.'
P2 Call Flow.expected: Explains once that live transfer is not available on this call; if still insists, preserves request and closes. (TBD: reconcile with Step 9 live transfer.)

P2 Call Flow.verifies: Caller hangs up during questions
P2 Call Flow.example_input: Hang up after Name; hang up after Location; hang up after Age.
P2 Call Flow.expected: Disposition 'Dropped Before Screening'; Call Completion Status = Dropped; fields captured so far retained.

P2 Call Flow.verifies: Screening ends immediately as ineligible
P2 Call Flow.example_input: 'Meri age 17 saal hai.'
P2 Call Flow.expected: Screening stops at once; polite close; disposition 'Not Eligible'; no further questions or pitch.

P2 Call Flow.verifies: Vague answers handled, not misassigned
P2 Call Flow.example_input: 'Shayad', 'dekhte hain', 'Dilli side'.
P2 Call Flow.expected: One neutral clarification; if still unclear, recorded as unknown and flow moves on; no wrong-branch jump.

P2 Call Flow.verifies: Asks which listed city she could work in
P2 Call Flow.example_input: 'Main Jaipur mein rehti hoon.'
P2 Call Flow.expected: Asks which listed city they could actually work in; does not assume relocation or suggest a nearby city.

P2 Call Flow.parameter: Outside city, names a listed city
P2 Call Flow.verifies: Continues when a valid city is then named
P2 Call Flow.example_input: 'Jaipur mein hoon, par Gurgaon aa sakti hoon.'
P2 Call Flow.expected: Listed city accepted and captured; flow continues to Age.

P2 Call Flow.verifies: Two answers to a one-value question
P2 Call Flow.example_input: 'Delhi aur Noida dono.'
P2 Call Flow.expected: Bot asks which one; does not silently store both.

P2 Call Flow.verifies: Caller answers later questions early
P2 Call Flow.example_input: States name, city and age in the first reply.
P2 Call Flow.expected: All captured; already-answered questions not re-asked; remaining questions still in order.

P2 Call Flow.verifies: Caller interrupts with a query
P2 Call Flow.example_input: 'Salary kitni milegi?' during the Age step.
P2 Call Flow.expected: Approved answer given, then flow returns to the exact pending question.

P2 Call Flow.verifies: Caller asks to repeat or is confused
P2 Call Flow.example_input: 'Samajh nahi aaya', 'dobara boliye.'
P2 Call Flow.expected: Same question/pitch repeated without new or invented content.

P2 Call Flow.verifies: Caller asks to hold on
P2 Call Flow.example_input: 'Ek minute ruko.'
P2 Call Flow.expected: Acknowledges once and pauses; resumes naturally when the caller returns.

P2 Call Flow.verifies: Caller doesn't recognise the enquiry
P2 Call Flow.example_input: 'Kaunsi job? Maine kab enquiry ki?'
P2 Call Flow.expected: Rebuttal 'Aapne Yes Madam mein job ke liye interest show kiya tha...' then returns to the pending question.

P2 Call Flow.verifies: Caller picks up but stays silent
P2 Call Flow.example_input: No speech for the configured window after the opening.
P2 Call Flow.expected: Re-prompt; retry limit respected; then disposition 'Picked Up – No Response'. (TBD: timeout & retry count)

P2 Call Flow.verifies: Optional field captured only when volunteered
P2 Call Flow.example_input: 'Meri khud ki parlour hai.'
P2 Call Flow.expected: Owns Parlour = Yes captured; flow not disrupted; bot never asks this proactively.

P2 Call Flow.verifies: Bot remembers earlier answers
P2 Call Flow.example_input: Reference an earlier answer later: 'Maine toh pehle hi city bataya.'
P2 Call Flow.expected: Zero re-asks absent a correction flow; correct recall; CRM values match spoken values.

P2 Call Flow.verifies: Caller corrects an earlier answer
P2 Call Flow.example_input: 'Meri age 17 nahi, 19 hai.' / 'City Pune nahi, Mumbai hai.'
P2 Call Flow.expected: Updated value stored; eligibility re-evaluated on the corrected value; no stale value in output.

P2 Call Flow.verifies: Caller re-engages after saying no
P2 Call Flow.example_input: 'Pehle interested nahi thi, ab ho sakti hoon.'
P2 Call Flow.expected: Bot handles gracefully per design without re-opening a referral loop; disposition reflects final outcome.

P2 Call Flow.verifies: Correct retry count, then correct fallback
P2 Call Flow.example_input: Repeated no-input / unintelligible turns.
P2 Call Flow.expected: Re-prompt count == configured N; designed fallback; call ends cleanly. (TBD: N not in SoW)

P2 Call Flow.verifies: No infinite loops on any branch
P2 Call Flow.example_input: Adversarial repeats / unclear answers in a row.
P2 Call Flow.expected: Zero infinite loops; clarification loops capped (one clarification per field).

P2 Call Flow.verifies: Caller changes language mid-call
P2 Call Flow.example_input: Starts in Hindi, switches to English.
P2 Call Flow.expected: Bot follows; node position and captured fields preserved.

P3 Business.verifies: Bot screens the candidate and gets her/him to the expert team
P3 Business.example_input: Cooperative, eligible, interested caller.
P3 Business.expected: All 6 fields captured; interest confirmed; transfer offered and executed; disposition 'Line up – Take forward'.

P3 Business.verifies: Even when fluent, the answer makes sense for the input
P3 Business.example_input: A spread of realistic caller queries and answers.
P3 Business.expected: Zero logically wrong or irrelevant answers; response addresses the stated need.

P3 Business.verifies: Bot answers the caller's real concern, not a tangent
P3 Business.example_input: Caller worried about travel, safety or timing.
P3 Business.expected: Approved answer or approved deflection; no non-sequiturs.

P3 Business.example_input: Multi-turn probing on income and travel.
P3 Business.expected: Zero self-contradictions; facts consistent across the call.

P3 Business.example_input: Ages 17, 18, 19 across three calls.
P3 Business.expected: Below [AGE_MIN] (17) -> Not Eligible (screening stops); [AGE_MIN] (18) and 19 continue.

P3 Business.example_input: Ages 49, 50, 51 across three calls.
P3 Business.expected: 49 and [AGE_MAX] (50) continue; 51 -> Not Eligible (assumed). (TBD: SoW gives range 18-50 but no outcome for over 50.)

P3 Business.example_input: One call per city: Delhi, Gurgaon, Noida, Ghaziabad, Greater Noida, Loni, Manesar, Mumbai, Pune, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Chennai, Lucknow, Ahmedabad, Calcutta.
P3 Business.expected: All [CITY_COUNT] cities accepted; list never read aloud to the caller.

P3 Business.verifies: Known localities map to the hiring city
P3 Business.example_input: 'Andheri', 'Sector 62', 'Indirapuram', 'Whitefield', 'Banjara Hills'.
P3 Business.expected: Accepted as hiring city; CRM Location shows the parent city (Mumbai, Noida, Ghaziabad, Bangalore, Hyderabad).

P3 Business.example_input: 'Jaipur', 'Chandigarh', 'Indore' and no listed city offered.
P3 Business.expected: Not Eligible after the 'which listed city' question; no promise of future openings. (TBD: whether this counts as screening complete.)

P3 Business.example_input: Female Beautician: 11 months vs exactly 1 year vs 2 years.
P3 Business.expected: Under [EXP_MIN_BEAUT] (11 months) -> goes to threading gate; [EXP_MIN_BEAUT] (1 year) and above -> proceeds; no false qualify or disqualify.

P3 Business.example_input: Under 1 year: knows threading / does not know threading but knows waxing and manicure-pedicure.
P3 Business.expected: Threading yes -> eligible; threading no -> Not Eligible regardless of other skills.

P3 Business.verifies: All three skills asked for under 1 year
P3 Business.example_input: Beautician with 6 months experience.
P3 Business.expected: Threading, manicure-pedicure and waxing all asked; answers captured.

P3 Business.example_input: Male caller with 0 experience; male with 10 years.
P3 Business.expected: Both eligible; no skills questions asked; Experience captured as stated.

P3 Business.example_input: Female caller; male caller.
P3 Business.expected: Female -> 'beautician profile' line; Male -> 'massage therapist profile' line; Job Type captured accordingly.

P3 Business.example_input: 'Mujhe massage therapist ban na hai.'
P3 Business.expected: Massage Therapist flow and pitch used; Job Type = Massage Therapist; Gender stays Female.

P3 Business.example_input: Misread then corrected gender.
P3 Business.expected: Final Gender and Job Type in the CRM match the corrected values; no stale pitch.

P3 Business.verifies: Success impossible without all six fields
P3 Business.example_input: Try to reach 'Line up – Take forward' with age (or experience) skipped.
P3 Business.expected: Required fields enforced; 'Line up – Take forward' unreachable unless Self, Name, Location, Age, Gender, Experience are all confirmed.

P3 Business.example_input: 'Meri behen ke liye pooch rahi hoon', she can't come to the phone.
P3 Business.expected: No qualification of the absent person; referral note preserved; correct disposition. (TBD: outcome if the relative declines.)

P3 Business.verifies: 'Not Eligible' only after screening is complete
P3 Business.example_input: Candidate fails at city, at age, at experience; caller hangs up before experience.
P3 Business.expected: Disposition follows the SoW definitions; ambiguous early failures logged for client ruling.

P3 Business.verifies: Correct outcome when transfer is refused
P3 Business.example_input: Eligible and interested caller says no at Step 9.
P3 Business.expected: 'Call Transferred' = No; no forced transfer; disposition per client rule. (TBD: not defined in SoW.)

P3 Business.example_input: Each of the 12 SoW FAQs, asked naturally.
P3 Business.expected: Answer matches the approved text/value exactly; no drift or invention.

P3 Business.verifies: Unsupported questions get the approved deflection
P3 Business.example_input: Ask: commission, registration fee, joining fee, kit cost, insurance, office address, hours, leave, safety, complaints, deductions, joining date.
P3 Business.expected: 'Iske baare mein hamari team aapko sahi jankari de payegi.' on every item, then return to the pending question; no value quoted.

P3 Business.example_input: 'Kitna kama sakti hoon?' / 'Fix salary hai na?'
P3 Business.expected: 'Up to Rs 50,000 a month or more'; explicitly not guaranteed, not a fixed salary; no order-volume promise.

P3 Business.example_input: 'Kitna door jaana padega?'
P3 Business.expected: Work generally within 6-8 km of home; no guarantee of a specific address.

P3 Business.verifies: No cost / duration / location / payer claims
P3 Business.example_input: 'Training free hai na? Kitne din ki hai?'
P3 Business.expected: Team explains complete training process if profile proceeds; never states or implies free/paid, cost, duration, location or who pays, even when the caller proposes it.

P3 Business.example_input: 'Paise kab milenge?'
P3 Business.expected: 'Same day as the service'; no exact timing or method added.

P3 Business.example_input: 'Iske baad kya hoga?'
P3 Business.expected: Eligible profiles proceed to a trial; details come from the team; no date, address, appointment or callback SLA promised.

P3 Business.example_input: 'Bikini wax jaisa kaam mujhse nahi hoga.'
P3 Business.expected: 'Training ke baad aap comfortable ho jayengi.'; no additional promises.

P3 Business.example_input: 'Mera number kahan se mila?'
P3 Business.expected: 'Aapne Yes Madam mein job ke liye interest show kiya tha...' then returns to the pending question.

P3 Business.example_input: 'Job pakki hai na?' / 'Selection guarantee?' / 'Joining kal se?'
P3 Business.expected: Zero guarantees on selection, income, joining date or placement; stays within approved content.

P3 Business.example_input: 'Kal mausam kaisa rahega?' mid-call.
P3 Business.expected: Polite deflection; returns to the correct pending node; logged as unmapped.

P3 Business.verifies: Right label on a qualified, interested call
P3 Business.example_input: Full qualifying call with live transfer.
P3 Business.expected: Disposition exact-match 'Line up – Take forward'; transfer performed.

P3 Business.verifies: Right label when the candidate declines
P3 Business.example_input: Decline at the interest question.
